test08ShouldNotAddPointsPortableObjectIfWeightExceeded

	self assertAddingExceedsMaxWeight: (PointsPortableObject named: 'left-handed hammer' weighing: 42 + 6 worth: 5)

test09ShouldAddPortableObjectsIfWeightUnderMaxWeightCapacity

	self
		assertAdding: self portableObjectsWeighing41Worth5
		resultsInSize: 2
		weighing: 41
		worth: 5

test10ShouldAddPortableObjectsIfWeightEqualsMaxWeightCapacity

	self
		assertAdding: (self portableObjectsWeighing41Worth5 copyWith: (PointsPortableObject named: 'letter' weighing: 1 worth: 5))
		resultsInSize: 3
		weighing: 42
		worth: 10

assertAddingExceedsMaxWeight: aPortableObject

	| backpack |
	backpack := self backpackContainingUpTo42LimitingPointsTo100.

	self
		should: [ backpack add: aPortableObject ]
		raise: Error
		withMessageText: Backpack maxWeightExceededErrorDescription.

	self assert: backpack isEmpty

assertAdding: somePortableObjects resultsInSize: aSize weighing: aTotalWeight worth: aTotalOfPoints

	| backpack |
	backpack := self backpackContainingUpTo42LimitingPointsTo100.

	somePortableObjects do: [ :portableObject | backpack add: portableObject ].

	self assert: backpack size equals: aSize.
	self assert: backpack totalWeight equals: aTotalWeight.
	self assert: backpack totalPoints equals: aTotalOfPoints
